name: TrailGenic Protocol-Matched Hikes
description: A bounded, field-grounded starter library that maps 22 California hikes and training routes to TrailGenic protocol level, primary stimulus, minimum readiness, recovery cost, repeatability, seasonal guidance, and evidence tier.
scope: Southern California core with California objective anchors personally completed by the TrailGenic founder.
selection_rule: A route is included only when it provides a distinct protocol job and has either founder field evidence or a clearly labeled protocol-mapped role.
interpretation_rule: Protocol fit describes the route under ordinary dry-trail conditions. Weather, snow, heat, closures, pace, load, fasting, and current recovery state can move the same route into a higher-risk category.
safety_note: This educational mapping is not medical advice, a readiness clearance, or a substitute for current official trail, permit, closure, fire, weather, snow, altitude, and rescue guidance.
supersedes: tg_accessible_trails_top100_v1 as the canonical recommendation layer; the legacy endpoint remains available for compatibility.

hikes.trail_name: Culver City Stairs + Baldwin Hills Scenic Overlook Loop
hikes.minimum_readiness: Comfortable continuous walking for 30–60 minutes with normal next-day recovery.
hikes.season_guidance: Year-round with heat, air-quality, and crowd adjustments.
hikes.why_selected: A controlled local hill-repeat environment for building consistency before mountain progression.

hikes.minimum_readiness: An established walking base and tolerance for rolling hills.
hikes.season_guidance: Year-round; avoid peak heat and verify fire or access restrictions.
hikes.why_selected: Adds sustained but controllable elevation without requiring an alpine environment.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Comfortable continuous walking for 30–60 minutes.
hikes.season_guidance: Generally year-round; verify reserve hours, parking, and closures.
hikes.why_selected: A low-consequence bridge from flat walking into real trail surface and short climbs.

hikes.minimum_readiness: A repeatable Foundation base with no unresolved recovery debt.
hikes.season_guidance: Cooler hours or seasons; verify heat, fire, and access conditions.
hikes.why_selected: Introduces a clear climbing signal while keeping total duration manageable.

hikes.minimum_readiness: A repeatable Foundation base and comfort on exposed rolling terrain.
hikes.season_guidance: Cooler hours or seasons; verify park access and heat conditions.
hikes.why_selected: Provides controllable rolling load and exposure without meaningful altitude.

hikes.minimum_readiness: A repeatable Foundation base and tolerance for sustained uphill walking.
hikes.season_guidance: Prefer cool hours; verify heat and trail access.
hikes.why_selected: A compact climb that makes pacing and cardiovascular response easy to observe.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Successful Foundation repetition and clean recovery from shorter hill routes.
hikes.season_guidance: Best in cooler conditions; verify heat, wind, fire, and park access.
hikes.why_selected: A scenic, repeatable route that increases climb and terrain demand without altitude.

hikes.trail_name: Echo Mountain via Sam Merrill Trail
hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeatable Activation routes with stable pacing and next-day recovery.
hikes.season_guidance: Prefer cool conditions; verify heat, fire, and Altadena access status.
hikes.why_selected: A clean sustained ascent suitable for comparing pacing and recovery across repeats.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeatable Activation performance plus comfort on steeper, less forgiving terrain.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry, stable conditions; snow, ice, wind, or heat materially change the classification.
hikes.why_selected: Adds meaningful terrain complexity before the higher-altitude Consolidation band.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeatable Activation performance with stable recovery after two-plus hours.
hikes.season_guidance: Cool seasons or early starts; verify heat, fire, and forest access.
hikes.why_selected: Extends duration and climb load without adding high-altitude complexity.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeatable Activation performance and adequate heat-management discipline.
hikes.season_guidance: Prefer cool seasons or early starts; heat can sharply increase recovery cost.
hikes.why_selected: A consistent mid-distance benchmark for climb economy and thermal discipline.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Multiple successful Adaptation routes with stable pacing and recovery.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; snow, ice, wind, road access, and fire status can transform the route.
hikes.why_selected: Introduces sustained exposure near 9,400 feet in a compact, repeatable climb.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Multiple successful Adaptation routes and reliable next-day recovery.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; verify road, snow, ice, weather, and fire status.
hikes.why_selected: A useful bridge between lower-elevation Adaptation routes and the 9,000–10,000-foot band.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Stable Adaptation performance across longer climbs and proven recovery discipline.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; snow, wind, road access, and heat materially alter risk.
hikes.why_selected: Compounds altitude, duration, and terrain without yet reaching full Protocol 5 load.

hikes.trail_name: Tahquitz Peak via Devil's Slide Trail
hikes.minimum_readiness: Stable Adaptation performance and confident footing on mountain terrain.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; verify permit, snow, ice, weather, and forest access.
hikes.why_selected: Combines a manageable duration with real high-country terrain and altitude.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Stable Adaptation performance across four-plus hours and proven recovery closure.
hikes.season_guidance: Cool, dry conditions; verify Chantry-area access, heat, fire, water, and trail closures.
hikes.why_selected: Creates a long mechanical and duration load without relying on very high altitude.

hikes.trail_name: Mount Baldy via Ski Hut Trail
hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeated Consolidation success, disciplined pacing, alpine-condition competence, and clean recovery readiness.
hikes.repeatability: High only in appropriate dry conditions
hikes.season_guidance: Dry summer–fall profile only; snow, ice, wind, heat, or storms create a different and potentially technical objective.
hikes.why_selected: TrailGenic's primary local repeat-route benchmark for altitude, climb, terrain, and recovery interpretation.

hikes.trail_name: San Jacinto Peak via Marion Mountain
hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeated Consolidation success plus demonstrated tolerance above 9,000 feet.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; verify permit, snow, weather, heat, water, and forest access.
hikes.why_selected: A steep, sustained ascent that exposes altitude tolerance and recovery cost clearly.

hikes.trail_name: San Gorgonio Peak via Vivian Creek
hikes.primary_stimulus: Extreme local duration, climb, and altitude integration
hikes.minimum_readiness: Repeated Protocol 5-capable training, strong altitude history, and verified recovery readiness.
hikes.season_guidance: Dry-season profile only; permit, weather, snow, heat, water, and access checks are mandatory.
hikes.why_selected: Southern California's clearest full-day integration test across climb, duration, altitude, and recovery.

hikes.minimum_readiness: Extensive Protocol 5 history, altitude preparation, permit, turnaround rules, and conservative condition assessment.
hikes.season_guidance: Permit and conditions govern; snow, storms, smoke, heat, and altitude can invalidate the ordinary route profile.
hikes.why_selected: A culmination objective, not a progression shortcut or routine recommendation.

hikes.trail_name: Mount Langley via Cottonwood Lakes and New Army Pass
hikes.minimum_readiness: Extensive Protocol 5 history, altitude preparation, navigation discipline, and conservative condition assessment.
hikes.season_guidance: Conditions and access govern; snow, storms, smoke, heat, and altitude can invalidate the ordinary route profile.
hikes.why_selected: A long Sierra integration objective that tests duration and altitude more than local repeatability.

hikes.trail_name: Half Dome via Mist Trail and John Muir Trail
hikes.minimum_readiness: Extensive Protocol 5 history, permit, cable-specific risk acceptance, dry conditions, and conservative turnaround discipline.
hikes.season_guidance: Cables, permit, weather, smoke, water, and park conditions govern; wet or stormy conditions materially change the objective.
hikes.why_selected: A culmination objective where technical consequence and duration matter more than peak altitude.
